_comment: Single source of truth for the pipeline's arms. Read by scripts/arms.py (Python)
and directly by run_all.ps1 (ConvertFrom-Json), so the arm list is never written twice.
Paths are relative to the project root.
Legacy arms keep their legacy output filenames (flashp_sucrose_response.csv,
solver_comparison.*) so the pre-refactor outputs stay a byte-exact regression
baseline. New arms get <arm>-suffixed names.
kind:           r_psoup = swept by run_psoup_sweep.R; python_flashp = by run_sucrose_sweep.py
base_network_dir: the PRISTINE FlashP export extend_sucrose.py copies FROM. null for arms
that are not sucrose-extended. The extension never edits in place, so the
base export stays exactly as FlashP built it and network_dir is the copy.
network_dir:    the network this arm represents
equations:      the algebraic equations build_apsim_parameters.py derives APSIM params from
sweep_network_dir: the network run_sucrose_sweep.py / compare_solvers.py sweep.
NOTE for flashp_suc this is the BASE benchmark while `equations` is _suc.
That divergence is pre-existing behaviour (run_sucrose_sweep.py:36 vs
build_apsim_parameters.py:170), surfaced here rather than introduced.
gene_map:       variant key into gene_map.VARIANTS
audit_key:      ortholog-map convention key used by audit_gene_coverage.py
extend_sucrose: whether extend_sucrose.py generates this arm's network
color:          Okabe-Ito, matching the palette in combined_figure_05.py
label:          short display name. Both FlashP arms are simply "Flash-P" -- the
node/edge counts printed beside the label are what tell them apart.
Those counts are NOT stored here: arms.py counts them from the
network_dir itself, so a label can never drift from its topology.
